mentions.name: cs2.sh
mentions.description: A price API for the Counter-Strike 2 market providing real-time and historical price data. It aggregates data from the third-party marketplaces that matter, where no simple high-quality API previously existed. Built with Go and ClickHouse, it is offered commercially and backed by a website.
mentions.problem: The Counter-Strike 2 market is distributed across many third-party marketplaces and there is no simple API providing genuinely high-quality data for the few marketplaces that matter.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m still working on a price API for the Counter-Strike 2 market that provides real-time & historical data.

evidence.value: I’m still working on a price API for the Counter-Strike 2 market that provides real-time & historical data.
